title: OutSystems partners are a displacement target on the same logic as Mendix, not a complement
content:
The research text for this group is two clauses long: not a complement, slot occupied, same displacement logic as Mendix. No demo, no integration point, and no OutSystems-specific reasoning is recorded — the conclusion is inherited from the Mendix analysis rather than derived independently.

That thinness is worth preserving as-is rather than dressing up. Anything more specific about how a displacement would work against OutSystems, or where its licence economics are weakest, would be new research and is not present in the corpus.

The cohort is six leads: three in PT, one each in NL, ES and DE. Their source rows record substantial partner standing — Elite, Premier and Premier Global tiers, one acquisition of another OutSystems consultancy — and five of the six are marked "9 · do not pitch", with the remaining one at "2 · decide thesis first". The qualification outcome and the partner depth point the same way, which is the practical reason this group produced a positioning note instead of a demo.

---

> NOT a complement — slot occupied. Same displacement logic as Mendix.
description: The slot is occupied at the app layer and the group carries no OutSystems-specific mechanism; five of the six leads are already marked do-not-pitch.
